name: IVAN SHABANOV

to: Re: Senior Frontend Engineer (Remote — European Region)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Frontend Engineer role on the Processing Engineering team at CoinsPaid Dev. Over the past four years, I have engineered production React and TypeScript applications specifically within high-volume fintech environments, mastering the Redux Toolkit ecosystem, complex state machines, real-time streaming, and performance optimization for critical transactional interfaces. CoinsPaid Dev's focus on engineering discipline, security, and developer ownership aligns directly with how I build software.

At Alfa-Dengi, a consumer-lending platform processing over 9,000 new leads daily, I solved two demanding frontend challenges. First, our platform required a visual status-driven campaign builder that allowed non-technical marketers to construct multi-step branching workflows with live frequency caps. I designed and shipped this canvas in React and NestJS on top of a normalized Redux Toolkit store, implementing immutable slice updates, graph validation, and undo-redo history. The tool runs in production with zero engineering support tickets and generates about $80K a month. Second, to eliminate severe freezing on our 100,000-row lead-scoring dataset, I reworked the frontend data path: by introducing client-side list virtualization, server-side pagination, and tuning PostgreSQL indexes, I dropped query and render latency from 8 seconds down to under 1 second.

Security and software quality are fundamental to my day-to-day work. When launching our credit-report product, I led a 3-engineer team through technical design, user flows, and Web API contracts over a 6-million-row dataset, turning the service profitable within its first week (+40% net profit). Across all user-facing surfaces, I follow OWASP Top 10 security standards, enforce strict input validation, prevent XSS vulnerabilities, and write comprehensive unit and component test suites using Vitest, Jest, and React Testing Library.

My core engineering stack is React 18+, TypeScript 5+, Redux Toolkit, modern CSS, Material UI, Vite, WebSocket, and Node.js. To accelerate engineering cycles, I also author project rules for Claude Code and build custom MCP servers, dropping delivery time for verified modules from roughly two hours to about forty minutes.
I work remotely from Yerevan, Armenia (GMT+4), providing full overlap with European working hours under flexible B2B contract or EOR engagement, and I am fluent in both Russian and English.

Given Coinspaid's processing across 20+ blockchain networks, where does your frontend team focus most when handling high-concurrency transactional interfaces: optimizing state machines for multi-stage payment confirmation flows, or ensuring sub-second UI responsiveness during market volatility spikes?
